selection: Positive 2024 validation net return, nonzero trades and no exit capacity failures; select highest net return. Test once in 2025.

events.continuation: stock return_30 > 0, NIFTY_50 return_30 > 0, stock volume_ratio_5_30 >= 1.2
events.relative: stock return_30 - NIFTY_50 return_30 > volatility_30*sqrt(30), median non-benchmark index return_30 > 0

learned_trade_gate: predicted gross return > estimated fees on two 10000 INR notionals / 10000 + 4 bps round-trip slippage + 2 bps margin; rule candidates take every event
exclusions: Stock or index session must have exactly 375 regular minutes; stock zero-volume or nonpositive candles rejected; stock corporate-action ex-dates excluded; no imputation; no historical sector membership inferred.
fee_assumptions: Brokerage min(20,0.0003*notional) per side; STT sell 0.00025; stamp buy 0.00003; SEBI both 0.000001; GST 18% on brokerage+exchange+SEBI. Estimated, unrounded; IPFT/contract-note reconciliation unresolved.
limits: Fixed survivor cohort, retrospective screening and known 2024 period remain development limitations; bar-volume capacity is only an execution proxy, not historical bid/ask or demonstrated fills. No claim of complete exchange-calendar verification. No real orders.
